D: A millionaire facing prison hires the man who washes his car to toughen him up before he goes inside.
P: Serve the mains when Darnell starts the training.
S: Crispy hot wings from the corner, tossed in a buttery hot sauce with ranch on the side.

Warm blinis with chive crème fraîche, smoked salmon ribbons and glossy salmon roe, a squeeze of lemon and dill, the millionaire's party snack. Warm 16 small blinis at 180C for 4 minutes. Mix 150g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp chopped chives and lemon zest. Top each blini with a spoon of the cream, a ribbon of smoked salmon (150g total) and half a teaspoon of salmon roe (50g total). Finish with a tiny dill sprig and a squeeze of lemon and arrange on a platter.
M: Barbecue chicken thighs with mac and cheese and greens, the family dinner James gets invited to.
W: James getting ready for his stretch in San Quentin

Silky dark chocolate pudding set in cups under salted cookie crumb, whipped cream and chocolate curls, canteen dessert done properly. Whisk 600ml milk, 80g caster sugar, 30g cocoa, 3 tbsp cornflour and a pinch of salt in a saucepan over medium heat until it thickens, about 6 minutes. Off the heat, stir in 80g chopped dark chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Pour into 4 cups, cover the surface and chill 2 hours. Top with whipped cream (150ml), crushed chocolate biscuits (60g) with a pinch of flaky salt and chocolate curls.
K: James King's millionaire mornings by the pool

Fresh cucumber juice shaken with tequila, lime, agave and a slice of jalapeño, poured over ice in a salt-rimmed glass with cucumber ribbons. Blitz 1 continental cucumber with 50ml water and strain. Rim 4 glasses with lime and salt. For each drink, muddle 2 slices of jalapeño in a shaker, add 45ml tequila, 45ml cucumber juice, 25ml lime juice and 15ml agave, shake with ice and strain over fresh ice. Garnish with a cucumber ribbon. For non-drinkers, top the cucumber, lime and agave with soda instead.

s.how: Bake 1.2kg chicken wings tossed with 2 tsp baking powder and salt at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter and serve with 150ml ranch.

m.how: Bake 1kg chicken thighs at 200C for 25 minutes, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and bake 10 more. Make mac and cheese from 300g macaroni, 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 500ml milk and 200g cheddar. Serve with 400g sautéed silverbeet.
